summary: Frontend-only test of the new /live page, the nav links and the homepage fixes, on desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844. Almost all requested items PASS. One HIGH visual bug: when scrolling /live, the Leaflet map paints over the sticky header on both desktop and mobile, hiding the logo, nav links, cart and hamburger. A minor beige strip (~23px) still shows under the mobile footer.
passed: /live: live-page renders, h1 'Live Location'. live-status-online is shown and matches GET /api/van-location is_online=true. No page errors.

Leaflet map renders (tiles load). map-location-status 'Live location not shared yet' shows (van status=offline) and does NOT overlap the zoom controls (status x=408, zoom ends at x=396 on desktop; mobile 72 vs 60).
check-nearby-btn is present (mode=mobile). Clicking it with geolocation denied shows 'Location access denied...' with Try Again and Request a Visit. Try Again restores the button.
How It Works and Today's Service Areas render (1 schedule-zone card).

Links to /live work: nav-live (desktop), mobile-nav-live (hamburger), bottom-nav-live (shows active on /live), secondary-street-location-link ('See Live Map'), footer-live-link. The bottom nav has 5 items: home/live/menu/cart/groups.

footer-logo loads on a cream pill (rgb 245,240,225) and is visible. how-it-works-book-button is 358px (full width) on mobile. No horizontal overflow on mobile (scrollWidth 390) on / or /live. Footer content sits above the bottom nav.

ui_bugs.issue: When the page scrolls, the map renders ON TOP of the sticky header. The logo, nav links, cart and hamburger are visually covered. RCA: the header is z-40 (App.css .header), while Leaflet panes/controls use z-index 400-1000 and the map wrapper creates no stacking context. Fix: add 'relative z-0 isolate' (isolation: isolate) to the map wrapper div in LivePage.jsx (h-[400px]) or to the LiveMap root, or raise the header z-index above 1000.

issues: A beige strip of ~23px is still visible between the footer bottom (y=748) and the bottom nav top (y=771) when scrolled to the end. The page has ~96px of padding below the footer; make that area dark, or put the padding inside the footer.
The CTA still reads 'Book This Package' when showing Custom Quote / Contact us. Consider 'Request Custom Quote'.

action_items: HIGH: Isolate the Leaflet map stacking context (e.g. className='relative z-0 isolate' on the map wrapper) so it no longer covers the sticky header on scroll
Minor: remove the remaining ~23px beige strip under the mobile footer
Optional: change the calculator CTA text for >50 guests
critical_code_review_comments: LivePage: isOnline comes from the shopStatus context, while the van GPS 'status' is separate. The hero says 'We're Online Now' / 'out on the street' even though the map says 'Live location not shared yet'. This is a bit contradictory for users. Consider wording that reflects the GPS status.
LivePage checkIfNearby uses the van lat/lng even when van.status is offline (the stale GPS seen here), so the distance may be computed against an old location.
Link wrapping Button (<a><button>) is still used; prefer Button asChild.
seed_data_creation: none; admin settings and van location not modified
context_for_next_testing_agent: The van-location currently has is_online=true, status=offline, mode=mobile. To verify the map/header fix, scroll /live so the map sits under the header (scrollTo map top - 20 on 390x844) and take a screenshot. elementFromPoint returns the header even though the map paints over it, so verify visually.
